# befui (HTML build)

Vendored from https://befui.vercel.app/html/ on 2026-10-14 (MIT licensed, https://github.com/befui).

- `befui.css`, `befui.js`: the custom elements (`<bef-button>`, `<bef-dialog>`, ...). Served by `apps/core/befui.py` at `/befui/`.
- `demos.json`: the 199 components with a demo each. Read by `apps/core/befui.py`, shown on `/design/`.

To update, download the same three files again over these. Do not edit them by hand.
